what_became_formally_true: No new Lean declaration. Existing named current closure-campaign targets survived their recorded compiler/axiom gates; historical replay targets retain only their pinned authority. All new mathematical results below are DERIVED and cross-reviewed.
new_derived_results: The attached actual low-primitive cut bound is6*C_F*B, uniformly in scale and cut. It removes the prior logarithmic cap loss; the already sharper total-sector bound is unchanged.
Normalized cut-total recovery has exact sup-norm cost(Y-1)/Y. This prices recovery, not the size of the actual observations.

The actual finite Arch action on a fixed translated H is exactly the restriction of one aperture-independent response. Its outer tails are positive, with leading exponent5/2; the full causal-prefix subtraction is explicit.
The complete canonical response echo retains the hypothetical zero-induced double pole. The Arch mixed term has at most a simple pole. Its rate remains the unresolved Theta, so no RH bound follows.

A two-sided taper and three fixed right bumps preserve the COMPLETE response echo while enforcing both source pole moments. The actual Arch tail yields an explicit positive determinant lower bound, and all repair coefficients costO(exp(L/2)).

At exactK=ceil(L^4), the complete repaired echo is represented by an ordinary native even/odd norm difference up toC*L^16*exp(L-c*L^(3/2)). Full early history, Arch terms and prime cutoff remain. This is neither a ground-state nor canonical-energy identity.

The actual eighth cumulative of the half-weighted self-echo has a positive degree5 upper bound. Below half-weight, every tested positive causal kernel with the required finite weighted moment retains both signs somewhere; no eventual-sign claim follows.

The literal finite even/odd inputs cannot coincide under unit-phase polar transport at late quartic cutoffs. Their input mismatch is at least a source-dependent constant/L, proved using actual Fourier source bounds. No signed response bound is inferred from input mismatch.

what_changed: The low-cut constant improves and the full canonical echo now has an explicit source-preserving native carrier construction. The polar/adjoint tests additionally expose concrete source-specific costs that cannot be silently set to zero.
upstream_implications: Use the exact fixed Arch response instead of an aperture-dependent error. Keep one-sided history distinct from bilateral transforms. Target recovery does not require a uniformly conditioned full edge inverse.
downstream_implications: The whole response, including its background and boundary corrections, can be compared with the existing finite OPICA machinery at the prescribed cutoff. Any resulting inequality must concern the ordinary norm difference actually represented, or supply a separate canonical-energy/ground adapter.
resurrected_route: Full-response native comparison is now constructible despite its nonzero early Arch history. The positive tail supplies an invertible third repair condition; right-end-only repair was insufficient.
new_lead: Seek a source-specific signed estimate for the complete response covariance or compensated high-primitive total. The new complete carrier allows that test without discarding background terms; it does not supply the estimate itself.
falsification_checks: Both-endpoint defects, wrong third correction RHS, overlapping reflected bumps, dropped pole scales, cost-free polar pairing and positivity after centering were explicitly checked. The actual-source tests reject these shortcuts; they do not establish the desired contradiction.
highest_leverage_next: Price the full signed canonical-response comparison using the actual correction coefficients and complete spectral/source covariances. Alternatively establish the exact compensated high-primitive lower bound with the rank-one term retained. Do not replace this missing estimate with another reconstruction or RH-equivalent wrapper.
remaining_missing_piece: An independent arithmetic bound strong enough to contradict the response forced by an off-line zero. It has not been proved in this pass.
